kind: independent source review of another author

scope: Native secure server helper delta and shared state/policy/dispatch; prior client source review remains a separate historical cut.

findings.name: Initial owner/generation/authorization before mutation
findings.details: Separate broker role; original device fingerprint rescanned around capture, strong hardware identity+preexport baseline, durable export record before binding. Accepted initial operation is joined on EOF/stop; ambiguous bind leaves record unresolved.

findings.name: Original attribute and phase state
findings.details: Pinned original kernfs attribute cloned per stub; same hardware/attribute/status checks; None/empty IF and original configured/null-driver IF are distinct live phases. Single FD write is preceded by durable Intent; USED is not called enumeration.

findings.name: Stub ownership and handoff
findings.details: Same UID/PID/starttime/boot owner required; state mutex makes one durable slot; helper sends only R and immediately drops its R copy, retaining K. Client rejects wrong socket type/domain/listener/named endpoints.

findings.name: Cancellation and operation ownership
findings.details: Queued global mutation guard acquisition watches stop/EOF; actual commit and cleanup blocking workers hold owning guard until terminal; frame actor consumes commit response even when caller waiter drops.

findings.name: Cleanup and retirement
findings.details: Only retained owned K is shut down. Stub shutdown waits AVAILABLE or original generation gone; slot clears only after verified cleanup+durable update. Export closes active stubs first without holding mutation guard, verifies availability, unexports, then independently checks complete baseline/gone before record retirement. Failures stay blocked/unresolved.

findings.name: Persistent state and roles
findings.details: Protected atomic store validates bounded new export records, restart blocks unowned old registrations; read-only root reconciliation requires ended owner and original baseline/gone/old boot. Secure pools disjoint from legacy and each other. Persistent channels fit bounded 32 helper connection limit.

limitations: No compilation/test/QEMU or device execution by this reviewer.
Source review cannot establish real enumeration, live cleanup timings, driver restoration or external administrator/hotplug exclusion.
Native binding/unbinding retains existing tool+sysfs TOCTOU limits; old attr capability does not make legacy tool unexport atomic with hotplug.
No statement that per-connection helper errors authorize automatic retry, re-export or replacement generation adoption.
